name: notion-cli
description: notion-cli — full-featured Notion CLI with 39 commands for pages, databases, blocks, and the full Notion API

install_steps: GOBIN=$(go env GOBIN); GOPATH=$(go env GOPATH); ln -sf "${GOBIN:-$GOPATH/bin}/notion-cli" "${GOBIN:-$GOPATH/bin}/notion"
install_guidance.note: Primary install is `go install github.com/4ier/notion-cli@latest`, which builds a binary named `notion-cli`. Link or rename it to `notion` before the `Verify` step. Also available via Homebrew (`brew install 4ier/tap/notion-cli`), npm (`npm install -g @4ier/notion-cli`), GitHub Releases (https://github.com/4ier/notion-cli/releases), or Scoop on Windows. Token stored in ~/.config/notion-cli/config.json (mode 0600). Auto-detects JSON output when piped to another command.
